newsitem.title: RUSSIA: German president postpones visit to Russia.
newsitem.headline: German president postpones visit to Russia.

text.p: German President Roman Herzog has postponed a visit to Russia because of President Boris Yeltsin's planned heart operation, a Kremlin spokesman said on Monday.
Herzog had been due to visit Russia from October 12 to 14. The presidential spokesman stated that the trip would be re-arranged but did not say when it would take place.
Doctors said last week that Yeltsin, 65, would have a bypass operation in six to 10 weeks time to improve bloody supply to his heart. They have not yet set a date.
Yeltsin has been in Moscow's Central Clinical Hospital since September 13 and is expected to remain under medical observation until after the operation.
